question: Which two actions should be taken before an upgrade is started on a Cisco MDS switch? (Choose two.)
options: check the impact of the upgrade using the show install all impact command
free up space on the USB3 device by deleting old Cisco NX-OS image files
make the primary supervisor the active supervisor
theory: Before starting any MDS software upgrade, best practice is to validate the impact and protect against failure: running 'show install all impact' previews exactly which modules will be affected and whether the upgrade will be disruptive or nondisruptive, and backing up the running configuration ensures you can recover the switch's state if anything goes wrong during the install. Neither disabling CFS nor forcing a particular supervisor to be active is a required or meaningful pre-upgrade step. (CCNP/CCIE DCCOR Official Cert Guide, Chapter 11 - Software Upgrade)
